"""Temporary Modal CPU invocation of existing style/CI checks. Author: Winston Cai."""
import modal

app = modal.App('remnant-v41-review-style')
image = modal.Image.from_id('im-MZqnw8UUhUxovTFl16mxln').pip_install(
    'ruff==0.15.1', 'isort==7.0.0', 'clang-format==20.1.7'
)
volume = modal.Volume.from_name('remnant-stage2a-results')

@app.function(image=image, cpu=1, memory=2048, timeout=180, retries=0,
              max_containers=1, scaledown_window=2, volumes={'/results': volume})
def check():
    import hashlib
    import json
    import subprocess
    import time
    from pathlib import Path
    from scripts.modal import kernels
    from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import collect_tests, HWBackend

    volume.reload()
    root = Path('/results/microbench/v41-reviewfix-20261026-style/cpu')
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    manifest = json.loads(kernels.MANIFEST.read_text())
    assert manifest['sources'] == kernels._source_hashes()
    assert manifest['source_identities'] == kernels.SOURCE_IDENTITIES
    for path, expected in manifest['binaries'].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected
    sg = Path('/sgl-workspace/sglang-remnant')
    mla = Path('/opt/flashmla-remnant')
    fp4 = sg/'python/sglang/kernels/ops/attention/dsv4/fp4_cache.py'
    layout = fp4.with_name('kv_layout.py')
    test = sg/'test/registered/attention/unittests/dsv4/test_remnant_fp4.py'
    qualification = Path('/opt/flash-optimizations/scripts/modal/qualification.py')
    paths = [str(p) for p in (fp4, layout, test, qualification)]
    commands = [
        (['ruff', 'check', '--select', 'F401,F821,F823,UP037', *paths], sg),
        (['isort', '--check-only', *paths], sg),
        (['ruff', 'format', '--check', str(fp4), str(test), str(qualification)], sg),
    ]
    for name in ('native_h64', 'native_h128', 'packed_h64', 'packed_h128'):
        p = mla/f'csrc/kernels/sm90/decode/sparse/instantiations/v41_fp4_{name}.cu'
        commands.append((['clang-format', '--dry-run', '--Werror', '--style=file', str(p)], mla))
    for name in ('fp4_prefill_k512', 'fp4_prefill_k512_topklen'):
        p = mla/f'csrc/kernels/sm90/prefill/sparse/instantiations/{name}.cu'
        commands.append((['clang-format', '--dry-run', '--Werror', '--style=file', str(p)], mla))
    record = {'source_identities': manifest['source_identities'], 'commands': [], 'status': 'running'}
    deadline = time.monotonic()+150
    try:
        for argv, cwd in commands:
            result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, text=True, capture_output=True,
                                    timeout=max(1, int(deadline-time.monotonic())))
            record['commands'].append({'argv': argv, 'cwd': str(cwd), 'returncode': result.returncode,
                                       'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr})
        import io
        import unittest
        from scripts.modal import tests as launcher_tests
        suite = unittest.TestSuite(
            unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(case)
            for case in (launcher_tests.ContractTests,
                         launcher_tests.SurvivorBudgetLauncherTests,
                         launcher_tests.PrefillReadLauncherTests)
        )
        stream = io.StringIO()
        outcome = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stream, verbosity=2).run(suite)
        record['launcher_regressions'] = {'tests': outcome.testsRun,
            'status': 'passed' if outcome.wasSuccessful() else 'failed',
            'output': stream.getvalue()}
        registries = collect_tests([str(test)], sanity_check=True)
        assert len(registries) == 1
        registration = registries[0]
        assert registration.backend == HWBackend.CUDA
        assert registration.disabled == 'Modal-only H100 qualification'
        record['registration'] = {'backend': registration.backend.name, 'disabled': registration.disabled,
                                  'suite': registration.effective_suite}
        record['status'] = 'passed' if outcome.wasSuccessful() and all(c['returncode']==0 for c in record['commands']) else 'failed'
    finally:
        (root/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n')
        volume.commit()
    return record

@app.function(image=modal.Image.from_id('im-MZqnw8UUhUxovTFl16mxln'),
              cpu=4, memory=16384, timeout=420, retries=0, max_containers=1,
              scaledown_window=2, volumes={'/results': volume})
def legacy_cpu():
    import json
    from scripts.modal import kernels
    volume.reload()
    manifest = json.loads(kernels.MANIFEST.read_text())
    assert manifest['sources'] == kernels._source_hashes()
    assert manifest['source_identities'] == kernels.SOURCE_IDENTITIES
    with kernels._run_context('v41-reviewfix-20261026-legacycpu', 'cpu', 360, resource='cpu') as (root, record, deadline):
        tests = tuple(kernels.TEST_MODULES[name] for name in ('cache_format','pack','backend','compressor_store')) + (kernels.TEST_MODULES['pool']+'::TestRemnantPool',)
        record['tests'] = tests
        environment = kernels._cpu_preflight_environment(root)

    return record
